summary: The heartbeat proto is not validated against external storage and payload limits, allowing large payloads to be sent to the server that could cause activity or workflow failures.
userImpact: Users with large heartbeat payloads may experience unexpected activity or workflow failures without proper validation.
rootCause: Heartbeat proto is not visited with external storage and payload limits validators
proposedFix: Apply external storage and payload limits visitors to heartbeat proto
keyQuote: Large payloads could be sent to the server, possibly causing activity or workflow failures.
